run_memory_violation_detection: run the memory violation detection test on the litellm codebase to find potential OOM issues
check_file_memory_violations: check a single python file for memory violations like uncleared queue references and unbounded data structures
check_directory_memory_violations: recursively scan a directory for memory violations across all python files with configurable ignore patterns
create_custom_memory_pattern: create a custom Pattern subclass to detect new memory violation types by implementing visit_assign and check_cleanup
review_memory_violations: review the memory violations found in a codebase and get recommendations for fixing queue and data structure issues
